const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
task=root/'.ai/task/repair-w38-20260926'
window=root/'evidence/quality/repair-window-38-20260926'
pack_out=window/'orchestration'
manifest_path=task/'PACK-MANIFEST.json'
manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
# Revalidate every source and collision before any writes.
for x in manifest['files']:
    src=root/x['source']; dst=pack_out/x['relative_destination']
    data=src.read_bytes()
    assert len(data)==x['bytes'], x['source']
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==x['sha256'], x['source']
    if dst.exists():
        assert dst.is_file() and dst.read_bytes()==data, f'conflicting destination: {dst}'
# Capture protected file bytes.
protected={p:p.read_bytes() for p in (window/'IMPLEMENTATION.md',window/'VALIDATION.json')}
# Install pack.
for x in manifest['files']:
    src=root/x['source']; dst=pack_out/x['relative_destination']
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    if not dst.exists(): shutil.copyfile(src,dst)
shutil.copyfile(manifest_path,window/'orchestration-pack-manifest.json')
# Candidate catalog tree.
candidate=root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window38-20260926-candidate-catalog'
for src in sorted(p for p in candidate.rglob('*') if p.is_file()):
    dst=root/src.relative_to(candidate)
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(src,dst)
# Migration.
migration_src=root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window38-20260926-migration.json'
migration_dst=root/'evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/c67c525de5411f674069c31420a67d1c370a3f820cb84f90aeb755ecbec7d57b.json'
migration_dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
shutil.copyfile(migration_src,migration_dst)
# Publication attachments.
pub=window/'publication'; pub.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
names=['PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md','CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json','MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json','TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json']
names += sorted(p.name for p in task.glob('ADJUDICATION-*.json'))
names += ['HOST-EXECUTOR-AUDIT-execute-01.json','INVALID-F2A2.json','INVALID-F2A3.json']
for name in names: shutil.copyfile(task/name,pub/name)
art=root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window'
for name in ['window38-20260926-publish-chain.log','window38-20260926-publish-chain-timing.json','window38-20260926-migration.json','window38-20260926-migration-timing.json']:
    shutil.copyfile(art/name,pub/name.removeprefix('window38-20260926-'))
# Protected files unchanged.
for p,data in protected.items(): assert p.read_bytes()==data, p
print(f'installed_pack={len(manifest["files"])} candidate_files={sum(1 for p in candidate.rglob("*") if p.is_file())} publication_files={len(names)+4}')
